export interface RequestContext { readonly traceId: string; readonly userId: string; }
export type ActiveContext = RequestContext;

import type {ActiveContext as Context} from './context.ts';
export function logFields(context: Context) {const {traceId,userId}=context;return {requestId:traceId,userId};}

import type {RequestContext} from './context.ts';
export function headers(context: RequestContext) {return {'x-request-id':context.traceId};}

import type {ActiveContext} from './context.ts';
export function response(context: ActiveContext, payload: unknown) {return {requestId:context.traceId,payload};}

import type {ActiveContext as Context} from '../context.ts';
export function plugin0(context: Context) {return {requestId:context.traceId,tag:'plugin0',user:context.userId};}

import type {ActiveContext as Context} from '../context.ts';
